description: Run a YAML test file (tests: name, utterance, expect, continueConversation) against the published agent through cs_chat and report pass/fail. expect asserts on wording (contains, containsAny, notContains, regex, minLength, noSignIn) and on what the agent did (usedTool, notUsedTool, usedTopic, notUsedTopic, citedKnowledge), so a test can tell a real tool call from an answer that merely sounds right. Every result reports the observed topic, tool and citations whether or not it asserted on them. The CLI-native complement to portal evaluations. Pass writeExample to create a starter file.

botId.description: Agent (bot) id. Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_AGENT_ID.

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

conversationId.description: Continue an earlier conversation from cs_chat

environmentId.description: Power Platform environment id (GUID). Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_ENVIRONMENT_ID.

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

transport.description: auto detects the agent's authentication mode via Dataverse; directline for no-auth/manual-auth agents; sdk for Entra SSO agents

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

writeExample.description: Path to write an example test file, then return

name: cs_run_conversation_tests
title: Run local conversation tests
